If the present trends continue, Big Horn County will have a population evenly divided between Indian and non-Indian in 10 or 15 years.
The population of Hardin in 1970 was 2733 according to the U.S. Census. However, the 1973 census estimate for Hardin was 2,849 and local estimates placed the 1975 population at approximately 3,000 with sustained growth anticipated. Population of Big Horn and surrounding counties, as well as major towns, are presented in Table II-17 for the years 1950, 1960 and 1970.
Age Distribution
